parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: IpLike
parameters.description: The IP address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match against the added IP blacklist.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The sorting attribute. Results are sorted in **descending order** by the specified attribute. Valid values:

- **gmtModified**: sorts by modification time.

- **ip**: sorts by IP address.

- **templateId**: sorts by template ID.

- **id**: sorts by primary key.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return when paging is used. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the critical event protection IP blacklist rule.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the critical event protection template.

> This parameter requires the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after purchasing the critical event protection upgrade separately.
